decision.reason: Prefer the measured combined Sky Force gain of 3.05% with a 1.51% Snakes cost, consistent with the stated game priority. The syscall-only alternative gains 1.11% in Sky Force and loses 2.36% in Snakes. Context-only and individual copy/reload components were not independently timed.
